people.name: Jesus

translations.web: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
translations.bsb: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
translations.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
